Qualification notes / responses:

3) SLOs and metrics: to size a Dedicated pool and propose SLAs, we'll need your target latency SLOs (P95/P99), token length distributions, and expected concurrency pattern over 24h.

Hi Emma —

Following Priyom's recap, a few technical clarifications on noisy-neighbor risk, isolation, and SLO commitments from a Dedicated standpoint:

1) What "noisy neighbor" means here: unpredictable tail latency caused by other customers' workloads contending for GPU or network resources on the same host or scheduler. On shared Hosted pools we mitigate with continuous batching and scheduling heuristics, but worst-case tail events can still occur under extreme multi-tenant contention.

2) Dedicated capacity behavior:
- Per-customer GPU pools (exclusive node tenancy) — your workloads run on reserved instances.
- Scheduler prioritization & token-limited execution lanes for production routes.
- Autoscaling policies: reserve baseline nodes for guaranteed throughput + burst pool for short spikes.

3) Isolation guarantees & SLOs:
- For Dedicated pilots we provide performance baselining and a runbook for incident isolation.
- Typical measurable SLO targets we can aim for: P95 < 120ms, P99 < 350ms for 512-token average requests on T4/A10G-class nodes; exact numbers depend on model family, quantization, and sequence lengths.
- We also expose per-route latency histograms, p95/p99 dashboards, and token-level cost breakdowns in the Console so you can monitor noisy-neighbor signals.

4) Private VPC/on-prem: this removes shared control plane network paths and enables your KMS/HSM. Lead time is ~6-10 weeks for standard VPC deployments (longer for air-gapped). We can fast-track compliance checks if you have an immediate regulatory constraint.

What we'll need from you to build a pilot (short list):
- Sample request traces (avg token length, tokens per request) OR a 24-hour qps profile
- Target latency SLOs (P95/P99) and CPU/GPU preference (if any)
- Any compliance gating items for Private deployment (audit/contacts)

If it helps, I can put together a one-week Dedicated pilot plan (scope, success criteria, rollback) and an estimated cost delta vs Hosted. Happy to run a 30-min SE call to walk through the pilot.

Proposed slots: Thu 11:00-12:00 or Fri 09:00-10:00 PT.

Cheers,
Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
